ideas.pitch: A visual debugging and state-inspection UI built on top of the starter agent source file to reveal hidden agent loops and memory limits.

ideas.title: AgentFlow Extension

ideas.problem_statement: Participants must analyse the provided agent, understand its architecture and existing functionalities, and further develop, enhance, or extend its functionalities to create a more efficient and intelligent AI-powered solution.
ideas.title: MultiAgent Guardrail Injector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on architectural enhancement and production-readiness, directly answering the criteria of making the provided agent more efficient and robust.

ideas.title: AgentMemory Graph Bridge

ideas.title: Autonomous Tool-Synthesizer
